title: sideritis spinulosa var. hirsuta
intro: Sideritis spinulosa var. hirsuta, commonly known as Rough Sideritis, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The plant has been reported to have various health benefits, including the potential to reduce anxiety and improve respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as sedative and expectorant properties. Sideritis spinulosa var. hirsuta contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
